subject: Request: Press/Logo Consent Exception — AlderBio (MSA/Order Form Redlines)
messages:
From: Tom Hargreaves <tom.hargreaves@alderbio.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: AlderBio Legal <legal@alderbio.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Press & logo - narrow exception request on MSA/order form

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — AlderBio is excited to move forward. One item came up internally from our comms and legal teams: the publicity clause in the standard MSA and the logo license in the Order Form.

We'd like to request a narrow, one-off exception so AlderBio can announce the partnership in a press release and use Redwood's logo in a short-term case study. The two asks:
- Permission to issue a press release with an agreed short quote (one sentence) where Redwood is named.
- Limited use of the Redwood logo in AlderBio's press materials and the case study (digital only; no co-branded products).

We can accept a 72-hour advance review by Redwood and can limit the logo to the assets in your press kit. If helpful I've attached our proposed language and a short draft order-form addendum.

Can you confirm process/timeline? We are hoping to announce within the next two weeks.

Best,
Tom
Tom Hargreaves
Head of Corporate Affairs, AlderBio
tom.hargreaves@alderbio.com

Attachment: alder_proposed_publicity_excerpt.docx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 26 Jan 2027 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Press & logo - narrow exception request on MSA/order form

Tom — thanks for the note and the draft.

Quick note on process: for anything that changes the standard MSA/order form publicity or logo license we need a short legal approval + a sales sign-off (Ben) for any commercial concessions. Practically that means:
1) We'll route a redline to legal for a narrow carveout.
2) Redwood legal will prepare a short amendment (or suggested clause) including an approval window and usage constraints.
3) We confirm marketing assets and logo guidelines (ideally you use our press kit assets).

Ben — can you coordinate the minor commercial terms (if any) and prepare the redline Ben mentioned on the call?

Tom — target timeline: we'll try to get a formal response within 48 business hours after legal review, but if you need the publish window earlier flag that and we'll prioritize.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Tom Hargreaves <tom.hargreaves@alderbio.com>
Cc: AlderBio Legal <legal@alderbio.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Jan 2027 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposed publicity carveout — suggested redline

Hi team — attaching a proposed redline of the MSA publicity paragraph and a one-paragraph Order Form addendum that limits logo use. Key points:
- Publicity: Redwood grants permission for a single press release naming Redwood with a one-sentence quote subject to Redwood's 72-hour prior review. Redwood retains right to request edits for factual accuracy only.
- Logo: AlderBio may use Redwood's unmodified press-kit logo assets for digital announcements and a single downloadable case study PDF. No changes to the logo, no inclusion on product packaging, and no paid advertising. Usage must include our standard attribution line and link to brand guidelines.
- Duration: One-off permission for this announcement; any further uses require repeat approval.

I attached two small files: Alder_MSA_redline_v2.pdf (redline of the MSA) and orderform-Alder_logo-license-annotated.docx (proposed limited license). If legal is OK with the wording below, we can finalize and Ben will update the order form.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: Alder_MSA_redline_v2.pdf, orderform-Alder_logo-license-annotated.docx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hargreaves <tom.hargreaves@redwood.com>, AlderBio Legal <legal@alderbio.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Jan 2027 16:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposed publicity carveout — suggested redline

Ben/Kimberly/Tom — reviewed the proposed language. High-level position: we can accept the limited, one-off carveout with two edits to protect Redwood's IP and testimonial process. Proposed edits included inline in the attached redline (AlderBio_MSA_redline_v2.pdf). Summary of the two edits:
1) Clarify that "factual accuracy" review cannot be used as a blanket veto for editorial content — Redwood may request edits only where statements are factually incorrect or materially misleading.
2) Add a short indemnity carveout for misuse of the logo (standard limited indemnity for brand misuse in the one-off permission).

Also propose adding: a simple metadata escrow on the quote (we capture final approved quote with date/time) so either party can show audit of the approved text.

If AlderBio is comfortable with those two minor additions, legal is prepared to sign off and we can convert the redline into a signed Order Form addendum. If you want faster turnaround, Ben/Kimberly — please confirm no commercial concessions beyond the one-off permission.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: AlderBio_MSA_redline_v2.pdf

Date: Fri, 28 Jan 2027 15:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposed publicity carveout — suggested redline

Laura/Kimberly/Ben — thanks for the quick review and the clarifying language. AlderBio is fine with the two edits you proposed (factual-only review and the limited indemnity for logo misuse). We are happy to provide a final, time-stamped approved quote and we can confirm we'll only use the press-kit assets you specify.

One minor ask: can Redwood agree to a 96-hour embargo instead of 72 hours? Our PR timeline would feel safer with an extra business day. If 96 hours is a hard no, we can accept 72. Also please send the final approved logo files or a link to the press kit we should use.

If we get the signed addendum this morning we can finalize our press copy and schedule the release for next Tuesday.

Regards,
Tom
Tom Hargreaves
Head of Corporate Affairs, AlderBio
